```ruby title="Ruby"

begin
  api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
  client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
  result = client.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Hello', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4', stream: true)).to_a
rescue StandardError => error
```
